# flights.lior-ai.com — llms.txt
# Flight search and comparison tool for Israel (Ben Gurion Airport / TLV)

> flights.lior-ai.com is a free flight search and comparison tool that helps travelers find the cheapest flights from Ben Gurion Airport (TLV), Israel. It compares prices across 6 sources simultaneously: Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Walla Tours, Issta, and Eshet Tours.

## About

- **Name**: flights.lior-ai.com
- **Type**: Flight search & comparison tool
- **Language**: Hebrew (עברית) and English
- **Region**: Israel — Ben Gurion Airport (TLV / LLBG)
- **Free**: Yes, completely free to use
- **Built by**: [Lior AI](https://lior-ai.com)
- **Contact**: lior@lior-ai.com

## What it does

The tool allows users to:
1. Enter flight details (origin, destination, dates, passengers, cabin class)
2. Compare prices from 6 major flight search engines simultaneously
3. View real-time flight results from Google Flights API
4. Access destination guides with seasonal tips, visa info, and hotel costs
5. Get savings tips for flying cheaper from Israel

## Key Features

- Searches 6 sources: Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Walla Tours, Issta, Eshet Tours
- Covers 70+ destinations from TLV across Europe, Americas, Asia, Africa
- Hebrew and English bilingual interface
- Destination guides for 12+ popular destinations
- Tips section with 9 money-saving strategies
- Airline information for 6 major carriers from TLV
- Seasonal deals section
- Email alerts for price drops
- Full accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA compliant)

## Popular destinations from TLV

Athens (ATH), London (LHR), Berlin (BER), Rome (FCO), Paris (CDG), Barcelona (BCN), Budapest (BUD), Prague (PRG), Batumi (BUS), Dubai (DXB), Istanbul (IST), New York (JFK), Bangkok (BKK), Larnaca (LCA)

## Low-cost airlines from TLV

- Wizz Air — largest low-cost from TLV (Budapest, Vienna, Sofia, Bucharest, Warsaw, Rome, Milan, etc.)
- Ryanair — Paphos, Rhodes, Milan Bergamo, Rome Ciampino
- Transavia — Amsterdam, Paris
